verdicts.reason: A shrinks the bottle, the hero product, to a tiny thumbnail tucked in the top-right circle where it can't be read, so the product is lost. Its body copy sits on the yellow circle at very small size, jammed into the bottom-left corner, and the oversized headline dominates the whole canvas. B keeps the bottle large on the left, layered over the green circle, so it reads left to right as a banner should. Its flaws: SOLSTICE sits under the headline in heavy spaced caps and competes with it, the body copy is tiny, and the yellow circle leaves the bottom-right corner empty.
